posts.title: Atlético beat Viking 2-0 as both strikers score, but Sørloth injury hits Barcelona trip
posts.description: Alexander Sørloth and Julián Álvarez both ended goal droughts as Atlético Madrid beat Viking FK 2-0 to reach seven points in the Champions League. Sørloth's muscle injury now adds to an injury list that already includes Lookman, just as Atlético face Barcelona and PSV. Atlético Madrid’s win over Viking FK revived their hopes of a direct top-eight finish. Three league-phase games remain, and one of them is away to PSV. Both of Simeone’s leading strikers found the net. Yet the night also added a new name to the injury list. Sørloth broke the deadlock by firing in a pass from Alejandro Grimaldo. Five minutes later, Álvarez’s free-kick crept in at the near post. It was his 27th goal in the Champions League. It was also his first Champions League goal at the Metropolitano in 210 days. The strike was his third of the 2026-27 season: one in LaLiga and two in Europe. Grimaldo was named Player of the Match. Viking defender Henrik Falchener was sent off late in the game. posts.title: Ten-man Bournemouth come from behind to beat Celta at Balaídos and top Europa League
posts.description: Celta Vigo lost at home to Bournemouth even though the visitors played most of the game a man down. The defeat extends a difficult run for Claudio Giráldez's side, while the visitors moved to the top of the Europa League table. Bournemouth came from behind to beat Celta Vigo 1-2 at the Municipal de Balaídos on Thursday 26 November 2026. With Javier Rueda García providing the assist for Aspas, Celta went into the break 1-0 up. The game turned soon after the restart. Álvaro Rodríguez, the Uruguay international, headed Bournemouth level in the 47th minute from an Amine Adli assist. Rayan then scored the winner on a counter-attack in the 78th minute, set up by Marcus Tavernier. Aspas was booked for dissent in the same minute. Celta controlled the ball but failed to use the extra man The match statistics show how much of the play Celta had. The hosts completed 527 passes from 607. Bournemouth completed 264 from 333. posts.title: Gordon double leads rotated Barcelona to 4-1 win in Baku without Lamine Yamal
posts.description: Anthony Gordon scored twice as Hansi Flick's rotated Barcelona beat Sabah FK 4-1 in Baku without Lamine Yamal. The win lifts them to fourth in the Champions League league phase before Atlético Madrid and Manchester City visit. In Baku, Barcelona completed the longest European away trip in their history and returned with a comfortable victory over Sabah FK. Hansi Flick rotated his side, and Lamine Yamal did not make the journey. Joy-Lance Mickels scored a consolation goal for the Azerbaijani champions. Sabah had won only one of their first four league-phase matches. One of their defeats was a heavy loss to Manchester United. Three goals in nine minutes settled the contest Goalkeeper Stas Pokatilov failed to deal with an Adeyemi cross in the first half. Gordon was on hand to turn the ball in and put Barcelona ahead.
